name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.98: machine detail Overview now shows the machines open alerts. A needs-attention panel at the top of Overview lists this machines unresolved alerts (critical first) with severity, age, detail and a resolve action, so the error badge on the machine list now has a destination when you tap in. Uses the existing GET /alerts?deviceCode=&resolved=false and POST /alerts/:id/resolve endpoints; no API change. Cumulative over v5.97.
